reached_sql:
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT c.cd_gender, c.cd_marital_status, c.cd_education_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt1, ca.cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) AS cnt2, cd.cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt3 
    FROM customer c 
    JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk AND ca.ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk 
    WHERE EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM store_sales ss, date_dim d 
        WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
        AND d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3)
    AND NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM web_sales ws, date_dim d 
        WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
        AND d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3)
    AND NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM catalog_sales cs, date_dim d 
        WHERE c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_ship_customer_sk AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
        AND d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3)
    GROUP BY c.cd_gender, c.cd_marital_status, c.cd_education_status, ca.cd_purchase_estimate, cd.cd_credit_rating
) AS _s
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating 
LIMIT 100
